item.title: OMP Usage 1.0.0
item.description:
## First public release
A native macOS panel for omp usage: compact provider rings beside the camera (or a floating capsule), an expanded dashboard with per-provider and per-account detail, and in-app updates.
## Install
```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhkimxx/omp-usage-panel/main/install.sh | sh ```
The script downloads this DMG, checks its size and SHA-256 against the digest GitHub publishes, installs the app to `~/Applications` and registers a per-user login LaunchAgent. No admin rights, no Node.js and no Gatekeeper prompt: files fetched with `curl` are not quarantined by macOS.
You can also download the DMG manually; a browser-downloaded copy is quarantined, so macOS asks you to allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security first.
Requires macOS 13+ and an authenticated omp that supports `omp usage --json`. Node.js 22 is bundled (about 49 MB for both architectures) and unpacked on first start.
The app is ad-hoc code-signed and not Apple-notarized. Updates are Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle.

item.title: OMP Usage 1.1.0
item.description:
## Notch lock for a selected monitor
New optional **Lock to selected monitor's notch** (Settings → Display → Panel placement), off by default. Existing settings upgrade with the lock off.
- With a named monitor selected, the panel stays attached to that monitor's notch, keeps (but ignores) your saved Option-drag position and blocks Option-drag. Turning the lock off restores the saved position. - The lock applies only while the selected monitor is connected and macOS reports a valid notch. System primary, notchless or disconnected monitors keep the existing placement; no notch dimensions are guessed. - The toggle is disabled for System primary, and a hint shows whether the lock is Off, Enabled or Inactive and why. Choosing a named monitor from System primary starts the lock at Off.
## Install
Installed copies update through the in-app updater. For a fresh install or reinstall:
```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhkimxx/omp-usage-panel/main/install.sh | sh ```
Requires macOS 13+ and an authenticated omp that supports `omp usage --json`. The app is ad-hoc code-signed and not Apple-notarized. Updates are Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle.
